assumptions: The CDS is in frame and the change is the codon substitution named.
limits: Ranks inner pairs by SpliceCraft's score; it does not screen them for dimers.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which primers introduce this point change in a CDS by SOE-PCR or QuikChange?

description: Design site-directed mutagenesis (SOE-PCR/QuikChange) primers for a point change on a CDS: the ranked inner mutagenic pairs, the constant outer pair, and the single spanning primer that replaces an outer when the site sits too near a CDS end. A design/write.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

cds.description: the CDS nucleotide sequence, in frame from the start codon.

codon_usage_tsv.description: codon-usage table the mutant codon is drawn from, as a Kazusa-style TSV. Left empty it is the built-in E. coli K12 table, which is what the panel's codon picker opens on. Advanced.

tm_model.description: Tm scale the candidates are scored and ranked on. The 55-75 °C window is calibrated for SantaLucia NN; `wallace` is upstream's primer3-free fallback, kept for golden parity. Values: santalucia (SantaLucia nearest-neighbor (Biopython Tm_NN defaults)), wallace (Wallace rule (4 °C per G·C, 2 °C per A·T)), gc:Chester_1993 (GC formula: Marmur-Doty (Chester & Marshak 1993)), gc:QuickChange (GC formula: QuikChange (the kit manufacturer’s own formula)), gc:Schildkraut_1965 (GC formula: Schildkraut & Lifson 1965 (Marmur-Doty + log[Na⁺])), gc:Wetmur_Melting_1991 (GC formula: Wetmur 1991, DNA (MELTING 4.3 approximate mode)), gc:Wetmur_RNA_1991 (GC formula: Wetmur 1991, RNA), gc:Wetmur_DNA_RNA_1991 (GC formula: Wetmur 1991, RNA/DNA hybrid), gc:Primer3 (GC formula: Primer3Plus product Tm (Biopython’s default set)), gc:Ahsen_2001 (GC formula: von Ahsen 2001 (accuracy against ease of use)).

name: design_mutagenesis_primers

candidates.description: the candidate inner primer pairs (with Tm)

edgeCase.description: set only when the site sits too close to a CDS end for an inner pair: the single spanning primer to use and which outer it replaces. Null otherwise

ntPosition.description: 1-based nt position of the changed codon's first base, counting from the start of the CDS (the engine returns `ntStart + 1`). This said 0-based until 2026-09-02 and it never was — a coordinate convention stated wrongly is worse than one left unstated, because a downstream node acts on it

outer.description: the constant outer primer pair (BsaI-tailed), each with its annealing Tm and GC
